message: Vector Rebel 3.2.66: after explicit physical inspection confirmation, finish and submit native SCBA inspections (including failed-item notes) once, then verify each receipt before continuing.
releaseNotes: Removed the retired Captain Monthly action and Monthly Captain columns/requirement from Daily Captain Check. Added Apparatus Check: scans native Standard SCBA Inspection Item Logs for each assigned airpack and shows per-tour Truck 504 and Medic 504 completion, plus Station 4 SCBA Room on C-shift Mondays only. The Apparatus Check grid now displays every discovered SCBA airpack by name underneath its location, with its own per-tour native-completed green check, missing red X, unknown-history question mark, future blank, or non-Monday station dash. The location summary is computed from the same per-airpack statuses and never substitutes for them. Green means native completed inspection exists for every current airpack; red means due and missing; ? means history cannot be fully verified; future blank; other station tours not applicable. It is read-only and respects 07:00 shift boundaries. SCBA airpacks default to Pass / Present / Working: one choice maps to all 11 verified native SCBA template 113271 questions. Missing marks all 11 checks as proposed Failed with a required comment only. Fail / Issue expands 11 individually editable checks, defaulting to proposed Pass, with a required comment. Specific answers are transferred into the official Vector form when fully reviewed, while unanswered checks are left for manual completion. Verified native template chooser now selects the exact SCBA Inspection checklist after physical review, and audits the form template before prefill. Time-to-form guard is extended for ordinary Vector hydration; approved reviewed SCBA inspections are submitted once automatically only after the inspector confirms physical checks and authorizes native submission; a Fail / Missing inspection receives the actual Vector FAILURE DETAILS note and exact failing item selection before its one-time final submission. A completion claim and next-airpack navigation require evidence of completed native form instance; failure or unknown status stops with no duplicate submit. Chooser blockers are reported through existing Rebel Command error telemetry. Live Vector failure details modal was inspected on Voyager: choosing Failed opens a required Failure Notes field and an item selection. Rebel now fills that native field from the exception comment and chooses the exact failed SCBA item. No inspection is submitted until the inspector explicitly confirms physical inspection and authorizes submission; the helper never retries an uncertain submission or claims completion without native evidence.
